edges.reason: _msgSender() is stored as the initial reflection holder and becomes the contract owner.
Caller-supplied from/to addresses and msg.sender comparisons drive transfer authorization and cooldown checks.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress, a simple single-address authorization.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress before sending ETH.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender() to gate privileged functions.
openTrading is protected by onlyOwner.
setBots is protected by onlyOwner.
delBot is protected by onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent is protected by onlyOwner.
Cooldown gate compares cooldown[to] with block.timestamp and writes block.timestamp + 10 seconds, a timestamp dependency.
Router swap deadline is set to block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
addLiquidityETH deadline is set to block.timestamp at launch.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call for the given token amount.
The router swap moves tokens out of the contract, re-entering _transfer; the inSwap lock via lockTheSwap mitigates recursive swaps.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading creates the Uniswap pair through the factory.
openTrading approves an unlimited router allowance on the pair.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to the team address.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to the marketing address.
manualswap delegates to swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend delegates to sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
_transfer forwards the resulting ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply reflection math.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the tax portion via _reflectFee.
transfer forwards _msgSender() and recipient into _transfer.
transferFrom moves funds through _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom reduces the allowance using _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
removeAllFee/restoreAllFee mutate the taxFee state variable around the transfer.
removeAllFee/restoreAllFee mutate the teamFee state variable around the transfer.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to the contract entry in _rOwned.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by the fee reflection amount.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee amount.
_transferStandard obtains r and t values from _getValues.
_getValues derives t-values through _getTValues.
_getValues derives r-values through _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate depends on supply values returned by _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned from _getRate.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer requires that neither side of the transfer is blacklisted in bots.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping for the recipient.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to gate swap logic.
_transfer enforces the amount <= _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before performing the automatic swap.
_transfer checks the inSwap lock to avoid nested swaps.
openTrading writes the hardcoded router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true as a one-time guard.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading reduces maxTxAmount to 50,000,000 tokens.
swapTokensForEth reads the router reference to build the swap path and approve.
sendETHToFee reads the team address as a transfer destination.
sendETHToFee reads the marketing address as a transfer destination.
setBots writes true for each supplied address in the bots mapping.
delBot clears the bots flag for the supplied address.
setMaxTxPercent overwrites maxTxAmount from the given percentage.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
balanceOf reads the caller's reflection balance from _rOwned.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance using tokenFromReflection.
allowance reads the nested allowances mapping.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance amount.
constructor assigns the whole reflection supply to the deployer in _rOwned.
constructor stores the team address argument.
constructor stores the marketing address argument.
constructor marks owner, contract, team and marketing as fee-excluded.
constructor initializes _rTotal from MAX and _tTotal.
constructor populates the inherited _owner variable via _msgSender().
The from parameter is consumed by _transfer for validation, blacklist and swap decisions.
The to parameter is consumed by _transfer for validation, cooldown and fee decisions.
The amount parameter is bounded by _maxTxAmount and forwarded to the token transfer.
The sender parameter flows from _tokenTransfer into _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter flows from _tokenTransfer into _transferStandard.
The takeFee local selects between removeAllFee and restoreAllFee inside _tokenTransfer.
The contract token balance local is passed as the swap input amount.
The contract ETH balance local is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is split and transferred by sendETHToFee.
The maxTxPercent parameter computes the new _maxTxAmount.
The bots_ array parameter is iterated to populate the blacklist mapping.
The recipient parameter is passed through the public transfer function.
The amount parameter is passed through the public transfer function.

Local balance measure used solely as the swap input for swapTokensForEth.
Local ETH balance used solely as the fee distribution input.
Transient token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
Transient ETH amount parameter split by sendETHToFee.
Transient percentage parameter used only to recompute maxTxAmount.
Transient address array iterated only inside setBots.
Transient recipient parameter of the public transfer wrapper.
Transient amount parameter of the public transfer wrapper.
